terms.definition: Classical Chinese distance unit of about half a kilometer.
Classical Chinese length unit of about 3.3 meters, used for heights, depths, and weapon reach.
Classical Chinese length unit of about 33 centimeters, traditionally the foot.
Classical Chinese length unit of about 3.3 centimeters, traditionally the inch.
Classical Chinese height unit of about seven chi, used for cliffs and abysses.
Classical Chinese weight unit of about half a kilogram.
Classical Chinese area unit of about 667 square meters, roughly a sixth of an acre.
Classical Chinese dry-measure unit of about 50 liters.
One of the twelve double-hours of the traditional Chinese day, two hours apiece.
